title: Xbox is officially embracing the chaos of AI-powered game ports
script:
Xbox is officially embracing AI to help port classic games to new devices.
Retro gaming is surging through code decompilations and recompilations on modern hardware.
Microsoft witnessed skateboarding modded into Call of Duty and Halo playing inside a web browser.
Xbox Labs is leading this exploration into advanced emulation and automated code ports.
Developers are merging code from two separate games into a single new experience using these tools.
Would you play classic console titles ported entirely by AI?
